functional_requirements.title: Facilitation-only role attestation at onboarding
functional_requirements.statement: The system shall require every onboarding producer or distributor to explicitly attest that they, not HarvestLink, hold Food Business Operator status for any trade facilitated on the platform.
functional_requirements.reasoning: Directly restates CON-01's mitigation_summary as a testable onboarding step.

functional_requirements.title: Foodservice buyer discovery and matching
functional_requirements.statement: The system shall allow foodservice buyers to discover onboarded producers and distributors by product category, location, and compliance-documentation completeness score.
functional_requirements.reasoning: The value proposition names 'direct buyer discovery' explicitly.

nfr_classifications.title: Facilitation-only role attestation at onboarding

boundary_conditions.boundary_condition: Attestation must be tied to an authenticated producer/distributor identity
Retain 6 years from creation, per Group Records Retention Policy

nfr_classifications.reasoning: Security follows from FR-001's own authenticated-identity requirement; Compliance is grounded in ES3's 6-year retention for trade/compliance-relevant records.

nfr_classifications.title: Foodservice buyer discovery and matching

boundary_conditions.boundary_condition: Search results must show compliance-documentation completeness score alongside each producer
Buyer search/discovery response time — TBD — needs stakeholder input

nfr_classifications.reasoning: Usability follows from FR-002's own completeness-score display capability; no response-time figure is stated in any input source, so Performance is TBD.
